## About
Deepa Auto Body is the Perth Amboy shop of Deepa Auto Repair, a family owned business with locations in Iselin and Piscataway as well. We do collision and body work here, along with general repair on foreign and domestic vehicles.
Damage gets measured and corrected on a Data liner system for unibody and frame straightening, and paint is finished in an oven baked paint room. For check engine lights and electrical faults, we use Snap-on diagnostic equipment with scan and scope.
On Google, Deepa Auto Body holds a 4.1 rating from 34 reviews.

## Services
- Expert Auto Body & Painting: Auto body, collision and painting, with Data liner unibody and frame straightening to laser beam accuracy.
- Computerized Diagnostic: Every Deepa location is fully equipped for computerized diagnostic work.
- Brake: Complete brake service, including power brakes, antilock brake systems and ABS light diagnostic.
- Front end service: A complete line of front end work on ball joints, tie rod ends, control arms, struts and shocks.
- Pre-Insurance Inspection: Pre-insurance photo inspections for insurance companies covered under CHECKPOINT.
- Towing Service: 24 hour flatbed towing, roadside assistance, jump starts and lock-out service.
- Shuttle Service: Drop off and pick up, so you aren't stuck waiting while your car is in the shop.
- Early Bird Key Drop-off Service: Leave your key before we open and we'll take it from there.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We do foreign and domestic auto repair and collision work.

Q: My check engine light is on. Can you find out why?
A: Yes. We read check engine, service engine soon and engine malfunction lights with Snap-on diagnostic equipment.

Q: How does the early key drop work?
A: Put your key in an envelope, write your vehicle information on the front and drop it in the Early Bird Key Drop Box by the front entrance. Please leave a phone number where we can reach you.

Q: Is there a warranty on paint work?
A: Yes. We offer a written limited lifetime warranty on paint jobs.
